block.ocr.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.ocr.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.ocr.model.title: OCR
block.ocr.model.description: Recognize text from local images and PDF pages, with word positions, confidence and explicit review issues.
block.ocr.help_allowed_root: Read boundary. Empty uses the runtime working directory; input files are never modified.
block.ocr.help_languages: Installed Tesseract language codes, for example ["eng", "fra"]. No automatic model download.
block.ocr.help_confidence_threshold: Words below this engine score are flagged for review, not silently discarded. This is not a probability.
block.ocr.help_first_page: First PDF page, starting at 1. Images contain one page.
block.ocr.help_last_page: Last PDF page; 0 means the last available page, within max_pages.
block.ocr.help_dpi: PDF rasterization resolution. Rendered dimensions are capped at 4096 pixels per side.
block.ocr.help_page_segmentation: Tesseract PSM: 3 automatic, 6 uniform text block, 11 sparse text. No orientation detection in this version.
block.ocr.help_max_pages: Maximum selected PDF pages; reject oversized ranges, never truncate silently.
block.ocr.help_max_characters: Maximum recognized characters across all selected pages.
block.ocr.help_timeout_sec: One total deadline including PDF rendering and recognition.
